evidence.title: Introducing Instance: Evaluation for Robot Policies
evidence.excerpt: Today Instance is launching and showcasing their success detector for robot policies — the first piece of what will eventually be fully automated robot evaluation. You can try it now at demo.instancelabs.ai. Describe a task, upload a video (or record one on your phone), and it judges whether the robot actually did the thing. Instance is @clairemao78 and @lucyjcai. They're MIT-trained computer scientists who've been friends since middle school. Lucy did humanoid robotics research in MIT's…
